notes: On the 90,916 lines whose vendor has no declared order day, defaulting R to 7 days orders 1.36x the cover that on-demand ordering needs (18.6d against 13.6d). R is a property of the ordering PROCESS, not of the supplier: a vendor absent from the calendar has not said it can only be ordered weekly, it has said nothing.
baseline: R defaults to 7d for a vendor with no declared day
